mapper.select: SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, MENU_SEQ FROM MENUS ORDER BY MENU_SEQ ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MENUS (menu_id, menu_name, menu_seq) VALUES ( (SELECT 'MENU' || TRIM( TO_CHAR(NVL(MAX(SUBSTR(menu_id, 5,2)), 0) +1, '00') ) FROM MENUS), #{menu_name}, (SELECT NVL( MAX(MENU_SEQ), 0) + 1 FROM MENUS) )
